reason: Decisions of the CEO on 2026-10-11. (1) Third-party costs of an engagement get a price rule per category: production, talent and printing with a 10% handling and a 5% floor; media and licences at cost. (2) A contingency reserve of 12% of the person cost for the two managed-service offers when sold On-Demand; none for staff augmentation. Both sets are estimates proposed by the agent that he accepted, to adjust with the first real job. (3) The country factors that were still estimates are closed as policy values: confirmed from 2026-10-12. Pricing policies, floors and every other record are untouched.
